scope_note: This inventory describes final product chains, not only entries in config/pipeline_registry.yaml.
confirmation_note: The four final chains are the product-owner taxonomy stated in conversation and cross-checked against prior Codex task summaries: DOCX math, DOCX English, PDF math, and PDF English. The repository does not yet encode this taxonomy as a canonical final-chain registry, so code paths below are evidence and candidates rather than a single source of truth.

conversation_evidence.summary: Older handoff grouped the work as three pipelines: DOCX, PDF math, and English image-PDF. This predates the later split of DOCX into math and English final chains.
DOCX native-first should preserve Word-native assets, OMML/formula structure, and document XML order; it should not default to rendering DOCX pages and reusing PDF visual crop logic.

English DOCX work is a distinct chain, with a protected downstream segment around group repair, field normalization, and parent-child projection. Thread evidence references old-local tools/config not present in this cleanroom baseline.
English PDF is image-PDF text-first, not plain PDF text extraction and not generic visual-first splitting. Reading, grammar, writing, and cloze are family branches inside this one final chain.

selection_rules.rule: Final chains are product-facing source/subject lanes. Technical pipeline registry entries can support one or more final chains but do not replace the final-chain taxonomy.
Directories or scripts marked backup, archive, probe, candidate, smoke, headcheck, chaincheck, legacy, or do_not_use_as_final are evidence only unless a final-chain manifest explicitly promotes them.
DOCX math and DOCX English must stay DOCX-native-first. Page rendering or PDF-style visual crop logic is fallback evidence, not the default path.
Reading, grammar, writing, and cloze are subfamilies of pdf_english, not four separate final chains.
